callees.name: validate_input
callees.post_condition: Raises ConfigWizardError when any required field of config is empty, malformed, or fails its format constraint. Returns with no effect when config is valid.

callees.name: adapter_for_api_style
callees.pre_condition: api_style is a recognized API style value.
callees.post_condition: Returns the npm package name string corresponding to the given API style. Raises when the API style is not recognized.
